purpose: Stage-0 self-supervised temporal reliability target audit; no reliability network or scheduler was trained or executed.
target_definition: Y_g(t,k) = product_{j=0..k} V_g(t,j), evaluated only where observed_offsets[t,k] is true.

arm.pointwise_validity: translation normalized RMS <= 1.0 AND rotation normalized RMS <= 1.0

gripper.pointwise_validity: normalized absolute error <= 1.0 AND sign(prediction) == sign(demonstration)

phase_comparison.reason: minimum demonstrated suffix after explicit late-phase boundary

scientific_checks.smoothness: Reported as mean and maximum adjacent change on each empirical prefix-survival curve.
scientific_checks.monotonicity: Individual prefix-survival labels are nonincreasing by construction. Curves use an episode-balanced Kaplan--Meier estimate so right censoring cannot induce artificial increases; pointwise validity is reported separately to test whether raw future validity itself falls with k.
scientific_checks.calibration: not_evaluable_without_a_probability estimator; this audit supplies empirical target frequencies and bootstrap uncertainty only. A future held-out estimator must report calibration slope/intercept, Brier score, ECE, and reliability diagrams.
scientific_checks.interpretation: These are oracle reliability targets under demonstrated-action consistency, not ground-truth horizons, task-success probabilities, or closed-loop safety guarantees.
